motionRules.sourceSelection: UniformAnimation resolves current Farmer state/frame to a full 16x32 authored source frame
motionRules.coverage: all decoration is clipped to, or deterministically extended from, the per-frame coverage envelope
motionRules.direction: FS selects a facing model; each model retains its official condition map
motionRules.water: appearance hides while swimming and while bathing clothes are active
motionRules.nativeOffset: disabled because pose placement is already encoded in each full source frame
